summary.text: Lyndsey Stough is an independent candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 44, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An architect, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has served on Sylvania City Council for six years.

paragraphs.text: Lyndsey Stough graduated from Sylvania Southview High School, and Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University (2009) and a graduate degree from the University of Michigan (2014).

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a third-generation architect in a small family business with more than 15 years in architecture, including projects for The Ability Center of Greater Toledo, TARTA and Owens Community College.
She said she has served six years on Sylvania City Council and is running as an independent because neither party has felt right to her.
Stough named public education as a campaign priority, saying the Fair School Funding Plan is underfunded in the current budget by $400 million and that the voucher system weakens public schools.
She also named lowering costs for residents, including restoring the Local Government Fund.
